name: render-zigzag-statement
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
b=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','5','-l','5','-singlefile','-scale-to','1300','-png',str(Path.cwd()/'sources/zigzag.pdf')],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
s=base64.b64encode(b).decode();subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/zigzag-page5.png','--base64'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print(s)
